component_patterns.hero: Dark navy-to-deeper-navy gradient with low-opacity category imagery; aqua eyebrow; white heading; blue-100 support text.
component_patterns.buttons: Rounded-xl. Primary teal #008080 with white text; hover bright teal #00C2B8. Secondary white with teal border/text and pale aqua hover.
component_patterns.cards: Rounded-2xl white SurfaceCard with subtle navy border, shadow-sm and hover shadow-md.
component_patterns.forms: Rounded-xl white controls with slate text and bright-teal focus ring.
component_patterns.category_media: Image-backed category/subcategory cards with restrained image height and teal hover border.

visual_grammar.tone: Trust-first UAE business discovery; clean directory utility rather than lifestyle luxury.
visual_grammar.icons: Functional, restrained; colour anchors remain navy/teal.
visual_grammar.imagery: Use relevant UAE/local-business category imagery as a low-opacity hero layer or card thumbnail, not full-screen decorative stock.
visual_grammar.graphics: For social/blog graphics, anchor with navy #0B3A6A, teal #008080/#00C2B8 and aqua #BCF3F0. Use concise trust/discovery-led headlines, restrained local imagery and strong hierarchy.

prohibited: generic Dubai skyline as default imagery when article subject is unrelated
overly ornate Arabic-inspired motifs not present in the site
mixing Abneos visual identity into UAEThrive assets
